decisions.reason: A rye country bread is a low-cost staple in a German bakery's range, its demand is still uncertain after one year, and keeping it open costs little.
The repeated gold medal from the Deutsches Brotinstitut signals that the premium raisin stollen's value is being realized, which justifies further commitment to this seasonal item.
The seeded rye mixed bread uses existing production lines and shows no negative evidence, so the option stays open cheaply while demand becomes clearer.
This dark malt rye bread is more of a niche product with somewhat higher overlap with the other rye breads, but one year is too early to judge, and keeping it costs little.
The marzipan stollen is a seasonal product sharing processes with the award-winning raisin stollen, so keeping it carries minimal cost while uncertainty resolves.
The ancient grain bread was promoted as the newest masterpiece and has trend potential, so it is a high-uncertainty option worth keeping open.
